resolution_blockers: Settlement table supplies grid references, not georeferenced polygons.
The PDF map is a reconstructed historical landscape and has no audited EU5 crosswalk.
Rapoport's ~75,000 estimate includes an urban Madinat al-Fayyum component that must be partitioned.
No source supplies a formal saturation interval or local-food calorie share.

citation_details: QMU map page states the map represents the mid-thirteenth-century landscape and describes its cartographic sources and lake-level assumption.
